components.name: Map model
components.purpose: Defines every kind of thing a map can hold. Reads a map file back and refuses one whose shape is wrong.

components.name: Shared map grammar
components.purpose: Holds the shared words and formats every other part of the map reads.

components.name: Map schema document
components.purpose: Writes a machine-readable description of the map file, for editors and other tools to read.

components.name: Map assembly
components.purpose: Merges the pieces each build agent returned into one map. Refuses two pieces that name the same thing twice.

components.name: Fragment self-check
components.purpose: Checks one agent's piece of the map before it is handed in. The agent that made a mistake is the one that fixes it.

components.name: Shape checks
components.purpose: Checks that every name in the map points at something real. Also checks that each code link is well formed and really exists.

components.name: Story checks
components.purpose: Checks the use cases, their flows and the happy path against each other. Reports the parts of the code no story covers.

components.name: Rule checks
components.purpose: Checks that each business rule names real code lines. Also writes down which files the map says guard access.

components.name: Wiring checks
components.purpose: Checks how the product connects: its interfaces, its ways in, the services it calls and the processes it runs in.

components.name: Data checks
components.purpose: Checks the saved records, their stores, who owns each data area, and how much of the map was verified.

config.purpose: Says this run really is mapping coyodex itself, so reading or writing the tool's own map is allowed.
config.default: unset, which makes the tool refuse to touch its own map
config.per_env: Not set per environment. One shell session sets it for that session only.
